digest: src/ has three TS modules (stop, cancellation, terminal) and no test files; several spec-deviating constants and predicates are observable in code.

implementationMap.observedBehavior: Default poll is 200ms (spec S3: 50ms) and floor is 1ms (spec S3: not below 10ms). Stop is detected from readWorkflowStopIntent or an aborted launch signal; read errors are swallowed in the watcher (.catch→undefined) and rethrown in throwIfWorkflowStopRequested. dispose() only clears the interval.
isWorkflowStopRequestedError also accepts messages by prefix, which the spec S6 forbids. Error name and message format `workflow stop requested for <runId>` match S2.
relatedSignals: S2 name and message format present

implementationMap.observedBehavior: Registers AbortSignal per workflowRunPath(cwd, runId); returned disposer removes signal and deletes the map entry when the last signal is removed. Matches S7 intent; S1 path (b) is checked via launchStopRequested.

implementationMap.observedBehavior: Accepts "cancelled" and "timeout" as cancellation markers beyond the three values C1 allows. Also treats value.cancelled===true and details.cancelled===true as cancellation. JSON content recursion (C2) is bounded because each level parses a strictly shorter string; the parsed!==value guard is effectively unreachable.

C2 recursion bounded by string length
